info.name: Lynxx Admin API
info.description:
Comprehensive collection for the Lynxx API gateway admin API.

- **Base URL**: `http://localhost:9001` (no path prefix; admin API mounted at root on port 9001).
- **Auth**: `Authorization: Bearer <token>` — token comes from `POST /tokens` (Admin role).
- **Roles**: Viewer (reads), Operator (mutations), Admin (token mgmt).
- **Response envelope**: All JSON responses are wrapped by the `api_envelope` middleware into an `ApiEnvelope` struct (`transactionUrn`, `responseStatus`, `data`, `error`, `referenceUrn`, `timestamp`). Set the `adminToken` and `baseUrl` collection variables before firing requests.
- **Config sub-router**: Live config endpoints live under `/admin/v1/config/*` (nested router).
